title: Madea Island
summary: Madea Island is an island located in an unknown location in the Aegean Sea at the center of the Atlantic Ocean. For many years it was home to the Titan, Madea, which is known for its illusions.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
While navigating the , the Huntik Foundation team's cabin cruiser suffered an attack and they decided to rest. After the Holotome designated Madea Island as the only suitable island nearby, the team came alongside it and met with Madea and the various women inhabiting the island.

Gradually, the team found themselves deep under the influence of the island's magic, each of them being assigned to an illusion tailored to their deepest desire. Eventually, Zhalia Moon destroyed the Obelisk originating all the illusions, while all the members slowly snapped out of their controlled state on their own. Madea revealed her true identity as an ill-spirited Titan, and she was defeated by Dante Vale. The team then found Madea's amulet alongside a tablet owned by Jason in the past, which would help them on their initial mission to find the Argo.

'''Madea Island''' is an island located in an unknown location in the [[Aegean Sea]] at the center of the Atlantic Ocean. For many years it was home to the [[Titan]], [[Madea]], which is known for its illusions.

==History==
While navigating the [[Category:Aegean Sea|Aegean Sea]], the [[Huntik Foundation]] team's [[Huntik Foundation's cabin cruiser|cabin cruiser]] suffered an attack and they decided to rest. After the [[Holotome]] designated Madea Island as the only suitable island nearby, the team came alongside it and met with [[Madea]] and the various women inhabiting the island.

Gradually, the team found themselves deep under the influence of the island's magic, each of them being assigned to an illusion tailored to their deepest desire. Eventually, [[Zhalia Moon]] destroyed the Obelisk originating all the illusions, while all the members slowly snapped out of their controlled state on their own. [[Madea]] revealed her true identity as an ill-spirited Titan, and she was defeated by [[Dante Vale]]. The team then found [[Madea]]'s amulet alongside a [[Jason's tablet|tablet]] owned by Jason in the past, which would help them on their initial mission to find the [[Argo]].
